# SplitMapViewState

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Split a viewState object into its individual components.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/split-map-view-state",
  "type": "SplitMapViewStateOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/split-map-view-state').par.viewState` (an input) and `op('/split-map-view-state').out.longitude` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.viewState`, `out.longitude`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|

<!-- gen:end inputs -->
